about: Proposed text_blocks.read_aloud overrides for screen and figure blocks: a short spoken description used by narration instead of the block's HTML. Drafted with model help from text_blocks.data.fields and the surrounding prose. Each is pinned to the block's sha256; if the block changes, the override no longer applies. status 'unreviewed' means no person has signed off yet.

overrides.read_aloud: The scoreboard, yellow against purple. Redball captures: six to eleven. Greenball player hits: nine to seven. Blueball pin knockdowns: thirty-one to twenty-three. Combined score: sixteen seventy-four to seventeen seventy-one.
The scoreboard again: yellow's greenball player hits are up to ten, and its combined score jumps to eighteen sixty, against purple's seventeen seventy-one.
On Febric's watch, from Gladias: a social recovery mode transaction request, for a wallet whose address begins oh ex eight F six two.
A message from Seila: Security question: what was the most unusual thing I did on the evening the kids came back from Vil and Daia's?
His reply to Seila: You unplugged the screen in the restaurant when it was showing Lord Ephelion's speech.
